scope: General blood-test education only, with the report's applicable laboratory interval. No pediatric, pregnancy-specific, disease-management or assay-specific targets.
overview: Blood creatinine helps assess kidney filtration but depends on muscle and other factors.
high: Kidney injury or disease may raise it; dehydration, muscle injury, exercise and meat intake can also contribute.
low: Low muscle mass, malnutrition or serious liver disease may lower it.
caveats: A single result cannot diagnose a specific disease. A within-range value does not exclude early kidney disease. This entry excludes urine creatinine and eGFR calculation.
